channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quaest: veja os índices de aprovação e desaprovação dos governos de 10 estados
item.description: The Quaest July 2026 poll shows relative stability in governor approval ratings across 10 states, except in Rio de Janeiro, where former governor Cláudio Castro has more disapproval than approval (a net negative of 26 points). Ronaldo Caiado (União) leads in Goiás with 87% approval, while Ratinho Júnior (PSD) in Paraná has 81% and Raquel Lyra (PSDB) in Pernambuco rose to 68% approval, the largest increase among those surveyed.

item.title: Lula e Renan Santos realizam convenções partidárias neste final de semana; entenda como vai funcionar
item.description: Lula (PT) and Renan Santos (Missão) hold party conventions in São Paulo this weekend to formalize their 2026 presidential candidacies. Lula will seek re-election with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate, while Renan run debut. Conventions, held between July 20 and August 5, are required for candidate registration with the Electoral Justice by August 15.

item.title: Lula e Milei, Bolsonaro e Fernández: como fica a relação de Brasil e Argentina com presidentes que se atacam
item.description: Despite exchanges of insults between Lula and Milei and a history of tensions between Bolsonaro and Fernández, Brazil-Argentina relations maintain strategic partnerships in trade and Mercosur, as state interests prevail over personal presidential disagreements. Experts say economic integration prevents political conflicts from becoming institutional ruptures, even with public criticisms and diplomatic gestures of dissatisfaction.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Quando será primeiro e segundo turno das eleições?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections will take place in two rounds: the first on October 4 and the second, if needed, on October 25. In the first round, voters will elect state and district deputies, federal deputies, senators, governors, and the president. The second round applies only to presidential and gubernatorial elections when no candidate achieves an absolute majority (50% plus one) of valid votes in the first round.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido do PL e mantém no ar vídeo de Lula com 10 dedos
item.description: The Ceará Electoral Court rejected the PL’s request to remove an Instagram video showing Lula with 10 fingers, ruling there was no direct vote solicitation nor proven irregular use of AI. The decision states that mentioning a pre-candidacy, praising personal qualities, and requesting political support are allowed absent a direct vote request, and that the visual effects are conventional editing techniques, not requiring an AI disclaimer.

item.title: Zema ironiza Lulinha em novo episódio de “Os Intocáveis”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) released a new episode of his AI-generated satirical series 'Os Intocáveis', mocking the investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over alleged influence trafficking in the medicinal cannabis market. The video portrays Lula as more concerned about the electoral impact of the probe than the investigation itself, referencing past cases like the Correios CPI and Banco Master, and shows Flávio Dino declining to interfere, citing the case's assignment to Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Acre: coligação confirma Tião Bocalom ao governo e Velloso ao Senado
item.description: The Produzir para Empregar coalition, formed by PSDB, Cidadania and Solidariedade, officially launched Tião Bocalom’s gubernatorial bid and Eduardo Velloso’s Senate campaign in Acre. The convention in Rio Branco also named sargento Adonis as Bocalom’s running mate. Bocalom, a former Rio Branco mayor and Bolsonaro ally, polls third with 17% voter intent, while Velloso, an ophthalmologist and former supporter of Governor Mailza Assis, seeks his first Senate term.

item.title: Em novo lapso, Lula diz não ter certeza de que vai ganhar eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) made another gaffe at the PT Convention in Ceará on July 31, 2026, stating he 'does not have certainty that we will win the elections in this country,' raising concerns about his bid for an unprecedented fourth term at age 85. Earlier that day, he said Cearenses have 'big heads due to their intelligence,' sparking debate over whether the remark was offensive or complimentary.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro patina em alianças e conta com Tarcísio para último apelo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to form political alliances, with PP, União Brasil, Republicans, and Podemos refusing or likely rejecting partnership. This leaves the PL senator as the main opposition candidate to Lula, but isolated, without support from major parties beyond his own.

item.title: Mendonça, quem compõe a polícia clandestina que investiga o DG da PF?
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça has opened a second inquiry against Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, over alleged obstruction of justice in an INSS case. The author criticizes the lack of impartiality, as Mendonça acts as investigator, judge, and external controller of the PF, forming what is described as a 'clandestine police' linked to the Supreme Court. The piece notes the investigation unfolds amid electoral tensions and questions the silence of the AGU and Justice Ministry in the face of what it sees as an abuse of power.

item.title: “Está posto”, diz Tereza Cristina sobre fim da articulação para vice de Flávio
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated she respects the Progressistas party's decision to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election, ending negotiations to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate. She ruled out an independent candidacy and affirmed she will continue supporting Bolsonaro's campaign despite the collapsed talks. The PP announced, after consulting state directories, that it chose neutrality and will not convene a national convention to define presidential support.

item.title: 'Enquanto eu viver, a extrema-direita não voltará a governar este país', diz Lula em convenção do PT no Ceará
item.description: Lula stated that as long as he lives, the far-right will not return to govern Brazil, downplaying the support of Trump and Milei for the opposition and emphasizing that his only desired help comes from the Brazilian people to preserve democracy. He also endorsed Cid Gomes for Senate and Gabriella Aguiar as vice-governor of Ceará, stressing the need to renew the Senate, which he described as 'half rotten'.

item.title: Gayer questiona governo sobre vistos negados a representantes dos EUA
item.description: Federal Deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) requested explanations from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding the denial of diplomatic visas to U.S. officials Riley M. Barnes and Samuel D. Samson, who intended to meet with Brazilian electoral authorities. The request seeks clarification on the legal and administrative basis for the decision, as well as whether other federal entities such as the Presidency, Abin, and the Federal Police were involved in the assessment. The visa denial came one day before Flávio Bolsonaro raised concerns about electronic voting machine security at an event with ambassadors, sparking fears of foreign influence on the election process.

item.title: ‘Se quiser vir Trump, que venha. Se quiser vir Milei, que venha. Não quero ajuda de fora’, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated he does not want foreign interference in Brazil's elections, challenging Donald Trump and Javier Milei to intervene but insisting he only seeks support from the Brazilian people to preserve democracy. He also emphasized the need to invest in technical and scientific education to compete with China and responded to Milei's insults, who called him a 'convict' and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes a 'trash bald'.

item.title: Lula cita Trump e Milei e diz não querer "ajuda de fora" na eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva rejected foreign support for his 2026 re-election bid, stating that Donald Trump and Javier Milei may aid his opponents but will lose the election. He emphasized wanting only the support of the Brazilian people to preserve democracy, responding to recent foreign interference attempts, including Milei’s participation in the PL convention and denied visas for Trump officials. Lula also advocated investing in engineering and math education to compete with China and counter Trump’s 'arrogance'.

item.title: Brasil vai acabar com “arrogância” de Trump, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazilians must invest in AI and mathematics education to compete with China and counter Donald Trump's 'arrogance,' speaking at a PT convention in Ceará. He emphasized that Brazil will not 'bow its head' amid rising trade tensions with the U.S., particularly following the 2026 second tariff round imposing up to 37.5% duties on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Tereza Cristina lamenta fim da articulação para vice após negativa do PP: 'O que foi está posto'
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) confirmed that negotiations for her to become Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate have ended following the PP's public rejection, stating the party will maintain neutrality and that she is not an independent candidate. She reiterated her support for Bolsonaro's campaign and said she respects the party's decision, even while expressing disappointment over the stalemate.

item.title: Com Lula, PT oficializa candidatura de Elmano ao governo do Ceará
item.description: The PT formally nominated Governor Elmano de Freitas for re-election in Ceará during a convention attended by President Lula. Elmano announced Gabriella Aguiar (PSD) as his running mate and highlighted achievements in health, education, and security while mocking opponents. Lula framed the election as a battle between truth and lies, urging voters to support Elmano, Cid Gomes, and PT candidates as part of a unified slate.

item.title: Lulinha protagoniza novo episódio de ‘Os Intocáveis’
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema released the ninth episode of the satirical animation series 'Os Intocáveis', titled 'Son of Lula, Lulinha is', which focuses on Lulinha, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The episode prompted Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes to file a complaint against Zema with the Attorney General's Office (PGR).

item.title: Tebet diz não ter interesse em ser ministra novamente caso Lula se reeleja: 'Já ocupei essa missão'
item.description: Simone Tebet, the PSB Senate candidate for São Paulo, stated she has no interest in becoming a minister again if Lula is re-elected, saying she already fulfilled that role in the current government. She said she delegated the decision on suplências to the party's National Executive and noted that the proposed names are of impeccable reputation. Tebet added that, if elected, she aims to serve eight years in the Federal Senate.

item.title: Com Lula, PT oficializa candidatura de Elmano de Freitas
item.description: The Workers' Party officially nominated Elmano de Freitas for re-election as governor of Ceará, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in attendance. The ticket includes Gabriella Aguiar (PSD) as vice-governor candidate and Senator Cid Gomes (PSB) running for Senate re-election. Despite Elmano's confidence, a Genial/Quaest poll shows Ciro Gomes (PSDB) leading by 10 percentage points.

item.title: Partido Verde oficializa apoio à candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The Green Party (PV) officially endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid for president in 2026 during a virtual national convention on March 31. The party emphasized its commitment to sustainability, social inclusion, and institutional strengthening. Lula's official candidacy will be confirmed only at the Workers' Party (PT) convention on April 2.

item.title: Cearense tem cabeça grande pela quantidade de inteligência, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised Ceara residents, saying they 'have big heads because of the amount of intelligence they have' during a visit to the University Hospital of Ceará in Fortaleza. He emphasized that the Northeast does not need to ask for favors and deserves respect due to the intelligence of its people. This is not the first time Lula has made similar remarks, having previously referred to Minister José Guimarães as 'big-headed from Ceará'.

item.title: Convenção do PSTU lança candidatura de Hertz Dias à Presidência em SP
item.description: The PSTU officially launched Hertz Dias as its presidential candidate at a convention in São Paulo, with Vanessa Portugal as his running mate. The ticket presents itself as a socialist and class-independent alternative to the far-right and the Lula government. The convention also nominated candidates for other offices in São Paulo, including governor, Senate, and state legislature.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza PF a investigar suposto tráfico de influência de Lulinha na Dataprev
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) for alleged influence peddling and corruption in Dataprev and Ministry of Health contracts. The probe also examines money laundering and criminal organization, involving lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS'.

item.title: PF investiga Lulinha em 2º inquérito por tráfico de influência na Dataprev
item.description: The Federal Police opened a second inquiry against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) for suspected influence peddling at Dataprev, authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The investigation examines whether businessman Cléber Ribas de Oliveira funded trips for Lulinha in exchange for favorable government contracts, also involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and 'Careca do INSS'. Lulinha's defense calls it a 'fishing expedition' to sway the 2026 elections, while Lula states his son will be treated like any other citizen.

item.title: Ao vivo: PT oficializa candidatura de Elmano ao governo do Ceará
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) officially confirms Elmano de Freitas' candidacy for re-election as governor of Ceará during a convention of the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PC do B, PV) in Fortaleza. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is among the attendees. The event is being streamed live.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza PF a investigar Lulinha; presidente Lula diz que filho ‘jura todo dia ser inocente’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to continue investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an interview that his son 'swears every day that he is innocent'.

item.title: OAB-SP repudia fala de Lula de que 'advogado criminalista não sabe defender inocente'
item.description: The OAB-SP repudiated President Lula's statements claiming that 'criminal lawyers do not know how to defend the innocent' and that 'criminal lawyers defend criminals'. The organization emphasized that criminal lawyers defend the Constitution, due process, and fundamental rights, and that such remarks promote prejudice, misinformation, and weaken the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: PSD e MDB fecham chapa para disputar o governo do Paraná
item.description: The PSD and MDB parties have formalized an alliance for the 2026 Paraná gubernatorial race, nominating federal deputy Sandro Alex (PSD) for governor and former Curitiba mayor Rafael Greca (MDB) as his running mate. The ticket is backed by seven parties, including União Brasil/PP, PSDB-Cidadania and Republicanos, with outgoing Governor Ratinho Junior (PSD) endorsing the pair. The coalition aims to secure statewide reach, broadcast time, and administrative continuity.

item.title: AtlasIntel: para 45%, família Bolsonaro é responsável por tarifaço
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg survey conducted between July 22–27, 2026 among 5,021 Brazilians found that 45.4% hold the Bolsonaro family responsible for U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, while 41.5% blame the Lula government. The poll has a 1-point margin of error at 95% confidence. Additionally, 47.9% disagree with Marco Rubio’s claim that Lula failed to negotiate in good faith, and majorities reject U.S. demands such as including Pix in negotiations (71% opposed) or eliminating tariffs on American ethanol (58% opposed).

item.title: Ministro do TCU apura relação de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro no caso Dark Horse
item.description: TCU Minister Benjamin Zymler has been appointed rapporteur of a Public Ministry representation investigating potential irregularities in the fundraising for the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The inquiry focuses on alleged links between Flávio Bolsonaro and businessman Vorcaro in the context of the film's financing.

item.title: Missão faz evento com plano de governo de Renan Santos, open bar e ingressos de até R$ 7 mil
item.description: The Mission Party held its first national congress in São Paulo, launching Renan Santos as its presidential candidate for 2026, with Lieutenant-Colonel Aroldo Medina as his running mate. The event featured the presentation of Santos’ government plan to the TSE, the release of a 'definitive' edition of the Yellow Book by federal deputy Kim Kataguiri, and the participation of São Paulo councilwoman Amanda Vettorazzo, who coordinates the campaign. Ticket prices ranged from R$94 to R$7,000, including open bar, lunch with party leaders, and premium access, while Santos’ candidacy had already been confirmed via a virtual convention on July 20, with Federal Police escort deployed due to threats from criminal factions.

item.title: Republicanos lança candidatura de Tarcísio em SP, com discurso de Flávio e ausência de caciques
item.description: The Republicans party officially launched the re-election bid of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas at a convention in Ibirapuera Gymnasium, featuring a speech by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the absence of key Centrão figures such as Valdemar Costa Neto, Ciro Nogueira, and Gilberto Kassab. The event aimed to showcase unity among right-wing and center parties, with support from 12 political signatures, though not all party leaders attended in person. Tarcísio emphasized his first-term achievements and called for continuity, promising more jobs, investments, and development for São Paulo.

item.title: Nunes e Tarcísio cobram compromisso de Flávio para destravar R$ 12 bilhões
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) pressured Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during a breakfast meeting to commit, if elected president, to releasing approximately R$ 12 billion in federal funds stalled in the Casa Civil, intended for municipal and state loans from the IDB and World Bank. Nunes said R$ 4 billion from the city are frozen, while Tarcísio noted over R$ 8 billion from the state face the same delay, requiring federal authorization for disbursement.

item.title: “Não me encontrei com Flávio”, diz Michelle após crise
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro stated she has not yet had an in-person meeting with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following their public disagreement. She added that any decision regarding a potential Senate run for the Federal District depends on a conversation with former President Jair Bolsonaro, whom she says she is staying in close contact with.

item.title: Michelle fala sobre decisão de se candidatar ao Senado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she will decide by Saturday, April 1, whether to run for the Senate from the Federal District. She met with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto in Brasília to discuss her political future. The former first lady noted she is still consulting with her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, and feels constrained in her decision.

item.title: Tráfico de influência: Mendonça autoriza 2º inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized a second investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for suspected influence peddling related to business dealings with Dataprev and other federal entities, involving businessman Cleber Ribas de Oliveira. The probe is connected to Operation Sem Desconto, which investiges fraud in the INSS and has already led to the dismissal of officials. Lulinha's defense says it remains calm but claims it has not seen the new investigative documents.

item.title: Michelle cita prisão de Bolsonaro como limitador de campanha
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro says Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest is limiting her political campaign and delayed her Senate candidacy announcement for the Federal District, though she has already decided to run. She states the decision will be made jointly with her husband and that she avoids political discussions to preserve her recovery and peace of mind. The candidacy will be officially launched at the PL's DF convention on August 2, with Bia Kicis as the party's other Senate nominee.

item.title: “Injustiçado”: Michelle comenta suspensão de visitas de Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said former President Jair Bolsonaro feels 'unjustly treated' due to the 30-day suspension of visits ordered by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, though he is improving from his hiccup condition. She prioritizes caring for her husband and maintaining a calm home environment, avoiding political discussions to reduce tension. Michelle also noted her potential Senate candidacy is still under discussion with Bolsonaro and should be decided by Sunday, with expectations from the PL party and the PL Women movement.

item.title: Condenado por improbidade, Arruda recebe apoio de Caiado no DF
item.description: Former governor José Roberto Arruda, PSD’s pre-candidate for the Federal District government, received public support from Ronaldo Caiado, PSD’s presidential pre-candidate, who praised him as one of the 'best minds' he knows. They met on Wednesday and Caiado will attend Arruda’s convention this Saturday. Despite a June ruling by the DF Justice upholding Arruda’s conviction for administrative impropriety in Operation Pandora’s Box — including a R$1 million fine and R$257 million in restitution — his defense claims the decision does not affect his eligibility for the 2026 election.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza investigação da PF sobre atuação de Lulinha na Dataprev por suspeita de tráfico de influência
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça authorized a new Federal Police investigation into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, regarding his alleged actions at Dataprev, the public entity managing INSS data. The probe examines whether Lulinha used his government connections to secure contracts, following prior links to pension discount fraud and medicinal cannabis schemes. Tensions exist between the PF and Mendonça’s office over whether this case is connected to earlier investigations.

item.title: OAB-SP repudia fala de Lula sobre criminalistas: "Preconceito inaceitável"
item.description: The OAB-SP condemned statements made by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in an interview on the Inteligência Ltda. podcast, where he claimed that 'criminal lawyers don’t know how to defend the innocent' and that 'criminal lawyers defend criminals'. The bar association labeled the remarks as 'unacceptable prejudice', emphasizing that criminal lawyers defend the Constitution, due process, and fundamental guarantees essential to the Democratic Rule of Law. The statement was issued three days before the PT convention that formally launched Lula’s 2022 re-election bid.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do Brasil
item.description: Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, while Lula is numerically ahead in Minas Gerais, within the margin of error. Together, these three states account for 39.90% of Brazil's electorate and will be decisive in the 2026 presidential race. The differences between candidates are small in all scenarios, indicating a fragile balance in the country's key electoral regions.

item.title: Para 49%, Brasil não deve retaliar os EUA pelo tarifaço
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows 49.3% of Brazilians believe the federal government should not retaliate against the U.S. for imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, while 38.5% support retaliation. Despite this, 47.7% view the tariffs as a threat to national sovereignty, and 53% think it is very or somewhat likely that the Trump administration will attempt to interfere in Brazil’s 2026 presidential election.

item.title: OAB-SP repudia fala de Lula sobre advogados criminalistas
item.description: The OAB-SP rejected President Lula's statements claiming that criminal lawyers 'do not know how to defend innocents' and 'defend bandits'. The association called the remarks offensive and damaging to the legal profession, emphasizing the essential role of technical defense in a Democratic State of Law. The statement followed Lula's interview on the Inteligência Ltda podcast on Thursday, the 30th.

item.title: Paraguai cobra do Brasil devolução de canhões e troféus da guerra
item.description: The Paraguayan government delivered an official note to Brazil's ambassador in Asunción, expressing 'displeasure and absolute rejection' of President Lula's remarks about the Paraguayan War. The document demands the return of cannons and war trophies seized during the 19th-century conflict.

item.title: OAB-SP critica fala de Lula sobre atuação de advogados criminalistas: 'Preconceito inaceitável'
item.description: The São Paulo Bar Association (OAB-SP) criticized Lula's statement that criminal defense lawyers 'do not know how to defend innocents', calling it an 'unacceptable prejudice'. The organization emphasized the essential role these professionals play in the justice system.

item.title: Michelle diz não ter se reunido com Flávio após crise e cita provável encontro em convenção do DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she has not yet met in person with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro since their public disagreement, emphasizing her focus on caring for former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is experiencing hiccups. She plans to decide on a Senate run in the Federal District together with her husband, with an announcement expected Sunday at the PL party convention, where she hopes to meet Flávio if he attends.

item.title: Michelle diz estar presa com Bolsonaro e definirá candidatura com ele
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she feels 'trapped' with Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, which prevents her from campaigning. She stated she will decide her Senate candidacy by Saturday (August 1) after consulting with him, and will announce her decision at the PL convention on Sunday (August 2). Her priority is caring for Jair and maintaining a peaceful home, avoiding political discussions.
